headline.en: Informatics Engineering student · software, AI & IoT builder · student organization leader
headline.id: Mahasiswa Informatika · pembangun software, AI & IoT · pemimpin organisasi mahasiswa

summaryVerbatim.en: Dimas Panca Pamungkas is an Informatics Engineering student at Sultan Ageng Tirtayasa University with experience in leadership, software development, and intelligent automation. He has served as an ANBK Operator and Technician, Educational Foundation Secretary, and Project Manager, while actively participating in student organizations. His interests include software engineering, IoT, and AI, supported by multiple national achievements in hackathons, business innovation, and essay competitions.

bio.en: I'm Dimas, an Informatics student from Serang who builds software, AI and IoT systems — and leads the teams around them. I'm the President of HMIF at UNTIRTA, I managed a multiplayer game delivered inside RedDoorz, and I keep turning ideas into things that win.
bio.id: Saya Dimas, mahasiswa Informatika dari Serang yang membangun software, AI, dan sistem IoT — sekaligus memimpin tim di sekitarnya. Saya Ketua HMIF FT UNTIRTA, memimpin proyek game multiplayer yang dipakai internal RedDoorz, dan terus mengubah ide menjadi karya yang menang.
